_about: Learned parameters for the Indian Cove nowcast. Produced by the microclimate study (Phase 1/2), consumed by nowcast.py -> nowcast.json -> the board. Bias offsets fill in as join_log.csv accumulates real rain events; everything else is seeded from the Phase 1 measurements.
generated_note: seed built 2026-08-24 from phase1 beam/blockage run

radar.why: Both NEXRADs overshoot ~a mile over the cove (KATX 5661 ft @103 km, KLGX 4646 ft @92 km; measured blockage 0% / 14%). Low-level rain is invisible. Direct radar/MRMS reflectivity is near-useless here and must be down-weighted; model + surface obs carry the nowcast.

bias_offsets._status: awaiting rain events in join_log.csv; null = use raw value

wind_regimes.name: frontal-SW
wind_regimes.note: onshore SW flow -- systems arrive from here

wind_regimes.name: pre-frontal-S
wind_regimes.note: veering ahead of a front, rain increasing

wind_regimes.name: post-frontal-NW
wind_regimes.note: showery, but convergence usually parks north of us

baro.note: surface pressure tendency (Open-Meteo pressure_msl or Tacoma PORTS). Falling fast => system inbound; boosts wet confidence.

blend._about: Crossfade from obs-extrapolation to model as lead time grows. weights sum ~1 across {minutely, hourly, regime}.

model_calibration.note: add temp_offset_f to model temp; multiply model precip by precip_ratio (rain shadow)
model_calibration.precip_ratio_source: Jarrell Cove CoCoRaHS (US1WAMS0032) vs Open-Meteo, 862 days -- accurate hand-gauge, supersedes G2160
